title: ParticleResizer
description: Allows scaling the particles for cleaner visuals.
body:
# Notice

**I've started doing Minecraft commissions in my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/Ce6Vty6khA)!**

# ParticleResizer

This mod is a code upgrade to my [Smaller Particles](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/smaller-particles) resource pack.
Instead of being locked to a single static resolution, you can now scale particle sizes in the configuration menu!
